name: Brain & morning light

overlay.caption: bright morning light → eyes → brain's clock moves earlier → sleepy sooner at night

does: Shows bright morning light moving the body clock earlier
Shows the shift building over days of the routine
Shows an earlier clock meaning less time lying awake at night
doesnt: Measure any real person — the numbers are illustrative teaching values
Include evening screens, caffeine, stress or weekends
Diagnose anything; everyone's clock drifts sometimes
limits.text: This is a simplified learning model. Real people vary with age, fitness and health. The numbers are illustrative, not measurements of any real person.
limits.wellbeing: If you're exhausted every day no matter what you try, talk with an adult you trust.

sources: NIH News in Health: 'Tired? Blame your body clock'
